name: temporal_deadline_cannot_rescue
description: A procurement notice is published outside the period although its bid deadline falls inside the period.

candidates.title: Metro tender deadline follows an old procurement notice
candidates.search_snippet: A Metro tender has a bid deadline on 18 September.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic procurement notice. The Metro published the tender on 2026-09-01 and set a bid deadline of 2026-09-18. The notice publication is outside the report period.

contract_notes: Notice publication controls; bid deadline cannot rescue an out-of-range procurement notice.
